reviews.name: Sandra Kim
reviews.title: Cleans and sanitizes all hard floors in one pass — no chemicals needed
reviews.body: With two toddlers on the floor all day, chemical residues were a big concern. This steam mop uses only water and heats to 145°C, killing 99.9% of bacteria. The washable microfiber pad lasts through dozens of washes. See the steam action photos.

reviews.name: Robert Green
reviews.title: Heavier commercial model is worth it — cleans our entire hotel in 40 minutes
reviews.body: We run a 20-room boutique hotel and needed something more robust than consumer steam mops. This commercial unit has a 1.6L tank and 2500W heating element. The steam is ready in 30 seconds and it continuously for 30 minutes. The carpet glider attachment is included.

reviews.name: Marie Dubois
reviews.title: Lightweight and maneuverable — cleans under furniture with the low-profile head
reviews.body: The triangular head reaches corners and the low profile (6cm) slides under our beds and sofas. The 360° swivel head makes it easy to navigate around chair legs. Steam power is adjustable between 2 levels. The 280ml water tank lasts about 20 minutes.
